newsitem.title: FINLAND: EFORE SEES LOWER YR TO END-OCT EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: EFORE SEES LOWER YR TO END-OCT EARNINGS.

text.p: Electronics component maker Efore Oy -- the former Finlandia Interface Oy -- said in a statement on Tuesday it expected earnings for its financial year to end-October to be below the previous year's record-high level.
"The periodic surge in activities which has been typical for the latter part of the operating year, started later than usual, in September," Efore said.
"This will also affect the financial result for 1996. The result will be below that in 1995 which was the best in the company's history," it said.
In the year to end-October 1995, Efore's profit before extraordinary items, reserves and taxes was 19.1 million markka.
Efore said the current year's net sales would increase to 185 million markka from 152 million.
